scientific_intent.scientific_task: Normalize each activation row by its channel mean and population variance, then apply channel-wise learned scale and bias
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: mean=sum(x)/C; variance=sum((x-mean)^2)/C or mean(x^2)-mean(x)^2; rstd=1/sqrt(variance+Float32(1e-5)); out=(x-mean)*rstd*gamma+beta. Return full output, mean and rstd.
scientific_intent.discretization: Six Float32 bases with (rows,channels)=(5,256),(7,259),(3,1024), bounded textured and exact constant rows each. Three native algorithms and six block widths32..1024 give108paths, scalar tailC259 and alignedFloat4C256/1024.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: All out/mean/rstd against independent Decimal80 central-variance oracle using actual Float32 epsilon, predeclared1e-5+2e-6|gold|; full actual input echo and guards exact, constant rows and zero gamma give exact bias outputs; finite positive rstd.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Selected small row counts and channel lengths, partial warp-per-row blocks at all widths; no full trained model or arbitrary large-offset variance conditioning.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 reductions, FMA variance/affine arithmetic and reciprocal square root. Moment-variance algorithm has a different cancellation sensitivity than two-pass algorithms; selected bounded and exact constant fixtures all pass unchanged budget. Float4 load/store alignment retained.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Repository identifies llm.c/GPT-2 layernorm forward as source context. This checks a neural-network normalization primitive, not trained-model accuracy, perplexity or backward gradients.
scientific_intent.description: Replace historical Julia affine touch kernel/fabricated success reports with all three real native layernorm algorithms and actual output arrays. Native source remains unchanged. Julia adds a shared-workspace read-lifetime barrier in block algorithm0; native tests pass, so static hazard is not an observed failure.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native header and reference.h identify layernorm forward/GPT-2; repository README layernorm links https://github.com/karpathy/llm.c . Native rmsnorm-cuda reduce/utils headers and installed CUDA cooperative_groups floating butterfly implementation reviewed. Earlier root RMSNorm helper patterns are reused with explicit provenance, not counted as independent cold framework implementation.
